questions.q: What is the relationship between Data Cloud and Data 360?
options: They are two unrelated products sold separately
Data 360 is the newer name for the Data Cloud platform, announced in October 2025
Data 360 is the old name, and Data Cloud replaced it
Data 360 is only a reporting add-on inside CRM Analytics
questions.explain: Salesforce renamed Data Cloud to Data 360 in October 2025. It is the same platform, and both names appear in documentation.

questions.q: Where does ingested source data land first in Data Cloud, kept in its original form?
options: A calculated insight object
A segment
An identity resolution ruleset
A data lake object (DLO)
questions.explain: Data streams bring data into data lake objects, which store it as it arrived, unaltered.

questions.q: What does mapping a DLO to a DMO accomplish?
options: It gives data from different sources a standardized shape so it can be treated consistently
It deletes the original source data
It publishes a dashboard to Tableau Next
It encrypts the data stream
questions.explain: Mapping fields into data model objects harmonizes sources, for example, different email field names becoming one standard field.

questions.q: Which capability links records from different sources that describe the same person into one profile?
options: Data stream scheduling
Calculated insights
Identity resolution
Workspace sharing
questions.explain: Identity resolution matches and unifies records belonging to the same individual or account.

questions.q: Why does this lesson say an analyst should understand Data 360, even if they only build dashboards?
options: Dashboards cannot be built without writing Apex
Newer tools like Tableau Next read their data from Data 360 objects, so it determines where numbers come from and how fresh they are
Data 360 replaces Salesforce Reports entirely
Analysts are required to administer identity resolution
questions.explain: Tableau Next depends on Data 360 for its data layer, so knowing DLOs, DMOs, and refresh behavior explains the origin and freshness of dashboard numbers.
